## mtcars via R package

Uses `pak::pak("posit-dev/ggsql-r")` + native R API. No shell pipeline, no
container — the Rust ggsql engine runs in-process via the R package.

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (!requireNamespace("ggsql", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pak::pak("posit-dev/ggsql-r")
}
library(ggsql)

reader <- duckdb_reader()
ggsql_register(reader, mtcars, "amazing_data")

ggsql_execute(reader, "
  SELECT * FROM amazing_data
  VISUALIZE mpg AS x, disp AS y
  DRAW point
  LABEL title => 'MPG vs Displacement'
")
```

## Palmer Penguins via R package

Same dataset as `embed.qmd` — DuckDB reads the parquet directly from the URL.

```{r}
#| echo: false
ggsql_execute(reader, r"(
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet("https://csvbase.com/calpaterson/palmer-penguins.parquet")
  VISUALISE bill_length_mm AS x, flipper_length_mm AS y, species AS color
  DRAW point
  LABEL title => 'Bill Length vs Flipper Length'
)")
```
